OWNERSHIP.PERSISTED_HANDOFF_AVAILABLE: Qualification harness immutable metadata publication; supervisor/reader validate exact expected hash/content
OWNERSHIP.PUBLISHED_TARGET_VERIFIED: Writer-side byte/identity verifier, corroborated by trusted harness/supervisor and rechecked by reader
OWNERSHIP.SAVE_RETURNED_SUCCESSFULLY: Actual native save caller; trusted supervisor authenticates successful writer protocol
OWNERSHIP.WRITER_EXIT_OBSERVED_BY_SUPERVISOR: Parent/supervisor only, actual wait/returncode; writer cannot certify its future exit

TRUST_RULE: Guard callbacks must authenticate actual supervisor observation. JSON booleans or writer-provided exit claims alone cannot create trusted runtime evidence.
